items.name: oauth-types
items.title: OAuth Types
items.description: Generic OAuth types for cantera components: providers, scopes, connections, accounts. The lingua franca adapters translate into.

items.name: aps-oauth-preset
items.title: APS OAuth Preset
items.description: Autodesk Platform Services (ACC) preset: provider metadata, scope catalog, scope bundles, and adapters into cantera's oauth types.

items.name: provider-sign-in-button
items.title: Provider Sign-In Button
items.description: A sign-in button for a single OAuth provider: brand icon, label, loading state. Works as a link or a click handler.

items.name: sign-in-card
items.title: Sign-In Card
items.description: A multi-provider sign-in chooser card. Server-renderable via an href template, or client-driven via a callback.

items.name: scope-picker
items.title: Scope Picker
items.description: A controlled OAuth scope picker: checkbox list with descriptions, one-click presets, and required scopes pinned on.

items.name: user-account-badge
items.title: User Account Badge
items.description: An avatar-and-name chip for a connected account, with optional provider mark. Server-safe.

items.name: token-status
items.title: Token Status
items.description: Status line for an OAuth grant: connection state, token expiry, and held scopes. Server-safe.

items.name: connection-card
items.title: Connection Card
items.description: A provider connection at a glance: account, grant status, scopes, and disconnect / reconnect actions.

items.name: acc-sign-in
items.title: ACC Sign-In
items.description: Complete Autodesk (APS / ACC) sign-in flow on aec-auth: consent redirect, code exchange, vault-managed refresh, signed session, and a live connection panel.
